messages:
maria: seeing a sudden spike in 502/504 gateway errors for hosted inference since the 03:00 deploy. customer support tickets piling up. rolling error rate from ~0.2% to 6% on /v1/generate, latency up too. any correlating deploys or config flips? :rotating_light:

ajay: saw Alert: gateway_5xx_rate > 5% at 03:07 from alert-bot. diving in. initial suspicion: proxy config change that landed in canary yesterday?

deploy-bot: deploy completed r/2025.03.12/003: proxy-config v2.14 -> v2.15 (canary 10% -> staged 50%).

ryan: that was my rollout. we promoted proxy-config v2.15 to 50% at 02:58 to improve connection pooling. I didn't see errors in canary metrics at 10%.

emma: several customers reported timeouts and 502s, example ticket #CS-4412 includes curl trace. they see failures from different regions. customers: AcmeCorp, Finlytics.

luis: grabbing logs from edge-proxy. quick grep:```
2025-03-12T03:05:12Z edge-proxy-1 ERROR upstream request failed: connect reset by peer
2025-03-12T03:05:12Z edge-proxy-1 WARN connection pool exhausted for backend inference-pool-a
2025-03-12T03:05:13Z edge-proxy-2 ERROR downstream request timeout to backend inference-node-12 (context deadline exceeded)
```

ajay: looks like pooled connections to inference backend are failing under increased concurrency. maybe v2.15 changed `max_idle_conns` default? Ryan can you paste the config diff?

ryan: diff (snippet):```yaml
proxy: 
  keepalive: true
-  max_idle_conns: 1000
+  max_idle_conns: 50  # intended to reduce fd usage
  connect_timeout_ms: 2000
```

maria: whoa 50 from 1000 is large change. that will close idle connections aggressively and cause reconnect storms under bursty traffic -> overwhelm backends or break warm-up. did rollout include the new default for all regions?

ryan: yes, v2.15 applied at staged canary levels across regions. I assumed inference-pool autoscaling handles it. my bad, forgot to check connection churn impact.

emma: we need immediate mitigation — customers are on the phone. suggestions?

ajay: two mitigation paths: a) revert proxy-config to v2.14 (fast path) b) patch config to increase `max_idle_conns` to safer value (e.g., 800) and roll forward. revert is simpler and quicker. I can coordinate rollback if approved.

luis: confirm: backends are healthy but thrashing on new connections. CPU on inference nodes spiked ~3x at 03:04 and kernel TCP CLOSE_WAIT counts rising.

maria: rollback approved. Ajay, initiate immediate rollback to v2.14 for staged and canary. Ryan pls stop further promotions. Emma pls ack to impacted customers that we're rolling back and will follow up.

ajay: running rollback job: `./deploy rollback proxy-config --from v2.15 --to v2.14 --scope staged --confirm`

deploy-bot: rollback started r/2025.03.12/003-revert. Canary 10% -> 0, staged 50% -> 0, global config set to v2.14 at 03:09 UTC.

alert-bot: alert cleared: gateway_5xx_rate dropped to 0.6% at 03:11.

emma: CS update sent to AcmeCorp + Finlytics: "We've rolled back a configuration change affecting connection pooling. Services are recovering. We'll follow up with postmortem." :thumbsup:

ryan: sorry everyone. I missed the connection churn test in lab. I’ll open a PR with a safer default and add a unit/regression test simulating connection bursts.

maria: next steps:
- ryan: PR with config change + tests, include load sim reproducer details
- luis: collect `ss -s` / tcp stats and kernel metrics for the window 03:00-03:12 and attach to postmortem
- ajay: mark incident, link runbook `runbooks/proxy-connection-churn.md`, note rollback timing and alert triggers
- emma: consolidate customer impact list and CS tickets

luis: attaching quick repro curl to simulate: `for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done` — observe increasing 502s with new config.

ajay: incident ticket INC-2025-0312 created and assigned. tagging eng-runtime and release.

maria: good work. postmortem owners: ryan (root cause + config dev), luis (metrics + evidence), ajay (operational timeline), emma (customer comms). Please have first draft in 24h. Closing thread for live mitigation.

ryan: will have PR today and add explicit rollback guard in future rollouts (check connection defaults on canary).
